title: How to Use GPT-6 Astra Voice to Control Your Computer
summary: Learn how to use GPT-6 Astra Voice with Computer Use, screen context, permissions, spoken task prompts, and VoiceOS workflows on Mac and Windows.
body_markdown:
### Why does GPT-6 Astra Voice answer me but not click anything?


Voice and Computer Use are separate layers. Ask Astra to use @Computer or name the target app, then confirm that the Computer Use plugin, server, and skill are enabled and that the app has been approved. On macOS, Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions are also required for visual control.\[6\]\[7\]


### What is a good first voice command for GPT-6 Astra Computer Use?


Try a narrow, reversible task: “Use @Computer to open Chrome, compare these two product pages, and put the differences in a new document. Cite the pages and stop before sharing or sending anything.” It names the app, the finished result, the evidence, and the review boundary.\[7\]


### Can I interrupt or correct GPT-6 Astra while it is working?


Yes. ChatGPT Voice supports interruption and follow-up steering, and OpenAI says Astra is better at incorporating new requirements without losing the original goal. Give the correction as a constraint—such as “keep the original tab unchanged”—then ask Astra to summarize the revised plan before continuing.\[1\]\[6\]\[7\]


### Why does GPT-6 Astra keep asking for permission to use an app?


Operating-system permissions and ChatGPT app approvals are separate. Computer Use asks before entering an app, and it may ask again for sensitive or disruptive actions. You can choose Always allow for an app you trust, but ChatGPT cannot approve macOS or Windows security prompts on your behalf.\[7\]


### Why does GPT-6 Astra take over my mouse and keyboard on Windows?


Computer Use runs on the active Windows desktop in the foreground, so the pointer and keyboard are part of the session Astra operates. If you need to keep working, use a different device, a separate virtual machine, or stop the Computer Use task before using that desktop yourself.\[7\]


### Can GPT-6 Astra use my Mac after the screen locks?


Only through the optional locked-use feature for Computer Use on macOS. It must be enabled in advance and is narrowly scoped to an active trusted task. It is not a general remote-unlock feature, and local keyboard or pointer activity causes the Mac to relock and pause automatic unlock.\[7\]


### Can GPT-6 Astra control Blender by voice?


OpenAI's launch film shows Astra working with a rocket model in Blender, and OpenAI describes Astra as capable of computer use in specialized software. Treat that as a demonstrated product direction rather than a promise that every Blender workflow will succeed. Start with a reversible edit, name the object and constraint, request a preview render, and review before saving over a file.\[1\]\[2\]\[7\]


### Should I use GPT-6 Astra Voice or VoiceOS Agent Mode?


Use Astra Voice when you want to converse with and steer work inside ChatGPT, Work, or Codex, and add Computer Use when a task must operate a visible app. Use VoiceOS when you want a dedicated desktop voice shortcut for actions across supported apps and connected tools. VoiceOS is not claimed to use Astra or have an OpenAI partnership.\[6\]\[7\]\[10\]
